user.title: myQ Authentication Mode
user.description: Select an authentication method for your Chamberlain / LiftMaster myQ account.

mode_automated.title: myQ Automated Login
mode_automated.description: Enter your myQ account credentials. Your tokens will be obtained securely using OAuth2 + PKCE.

mode_manual.title: myQ Manual Browser Login
mode_manual.description:
1. Open the following authorization link in your web browser:

{auth_url}

2. Sign in to your myQ account.
3. After signing in, your browser will redirect to a page beginning with `com.myqops://android?code=...`.
4. Copy the entire URL from the browser address bar and paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate myQ Account
reauth_confirm.description: Your myQ session has expired or the refresh token was rejected. Please re-enter your credentials to restore connectivity.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to myQ cloud servers. Please check your internet connection.
error.invalid_grant: OAuth refresh token was rejected. Re-authentication required.
error.no_code: No authorization code found in the provided redirect URL.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while communicating with myQ.

abort.already_configured: This myQ account is already configured in Home Assistant.
abort.reauth_successful: Re-authentication was successful. Session tokens updated.

init.title: myQ Polling Options
init.description: Configure the background polling interval for your myQ devices. To prevent cloud rate-limiting and account lockout, a random ±20-second jitter is automatically applied to every cycle.
